title: Tai Pao language
description: Tai language of Vietnam and Laos
extract: Tai Pao, known in Vietnamese sources as Tai Hang Tong, is a Tai language of Vietnam and Laos. In Laos, it is spoken in Khamkeut District, Pakkading District, and Viengthong District of Bolikhamxai Province. Two dialects of Tai Hang Tong are distinguished: Tai Pao and Tai Yo.
